== Summary ==
DecipherCon 2000 sidebar wordmark from Decipher's convention site, rotated to read horizontally.

* Original URL: http://decipher.com/images/deciphercon/2000/main/dconside.jpg
* Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001019031728/http://www.decipher.com/images/deciphercon/2000/main/dconside.jpg Internet Archive]
* Rotation: 90 degrees clockwise (original is a vertical left-column graphic)
